.. change::
    :tags: feature, autogenerate, multidb

    Enhanced the ``multidb`` environment template so that custom operations
    rendered for one database bind keep their own rendering context and
    imports through directive processing.   Each bind's
    :class:`.AutogenContext` now exposes its own ``renderers`` dispatcher,
    which falls back to the global
    :data:`~alembic.autogenerate.render.renderers` collection.
    A custom renderer registered for one bind therefore no longer silently
    takes over rendering of the same operation class in another bind, while
    operations without a bind-local renderer continue to use the existing
    default rendering.   Imports collected while rendering a bind are now
    emitted inline within that bind's own ``upgrade_<bind>()`` and
    ``downgrade_<bind>()`` functions instead of being shared across every
    bind's tokens.   See :ref:`autogen_custom_ops_per_bind`.
